ModDescription: Quest timers +60s (survive/defend quests excluded), thrown-object objectives replaced with "Defeat 10 foes", MSP +50%, EXP and rupies +20%, 9999 item cap, all fate episodes unlocked, quest grades 20% easier, captain not required in the story party, and crewmate cards for 1 Cobblestone in Treasure Trade. Every feature can be adjusted or turned off in Configure Mod. Applied in-archive at startup; the game installation is never modified.
